reports.title: Struggling with tax debt? Here’s what to know | Consumer Advice

pattern.name: Tax Debt Relief Upfront Fee Scam
pattern.description: Tax debt relief scam operators impersonate government authorities, send letters demanding contact by a specific deadline, then charge large upfront service fees before doing any work, leaving victims further in debt.

reports.title: What to know ahead of Open Enrollment to avoid health insurance scams | Consumer Advice

pattern.name: Open Enrollment lookalike insurance site
pattern.description: Fraudulent lookalike 'HealthCare.gov' sites that buy top search-ad placement during Open Enrollment, using official-sounding names and logos to collect premium payments and steal medical identity data.

reports.title: How to avoid deceptive sextortion assistance services and find real help | Consumer Advice

pattern.name: Deceptive crisis-assistance fee scam (fake sextortion help services)
pattern.description: Operator runs multiple 'assistance' websites charging victims large upfront fees for crisis-mitigation services that are never delivered, exploiting distressed principals at high prices.

reports.title: The FTC is not calling to deactivate your phone number | Consumer Advice

pattern.name: Government impersonation security-deposit scam
pattern.description: Impersonation scam where a caller posing as an FTC official (and a fake police officer) uses threats, fake credentials, and secrecy demands to pressure a victim into sending a 'security deposit' to a fraudster-controlled destination.
